name: InteriorCleanse Signature Candle
description: The signature pour: a soy-blend wax candle in a heavyweight vessel, scented with warm cedar, dried fig and a trace of smoke. Designed as an object first — it earns its place on the shelf long before it is lit. Roughly fifty hours of burn time, and a vessel worth keeping afterwards.
careNotes: Trim the wick to ¼ inch before each burn
Hand-poured soy-blend wax in a reusable vessel

name: InteriorCleanse Tote Bag
description: A structured everyday tote in heavyweight natural cotton canvas, printed with the InteriorCleanse mark. Wide enough for a market run, quiet enough for the office. Reinforced seams and long shoulder straps that sit properly rather than sliding.
careNotes: Reinforced seams and long shoulder straps
Machine wash cold, hang to dry

name: The Considered Home Print
description: A giclée art print on heavyweight matte stock — a study in warm neutrals, drawn for rooms that already have enough going on. Ships unframed and flat so it arrives without a crease, ready for the frame you already own.
careNotes: Giclée print on heavyweight matte stock
Handle by the edges; frame behind glass to prevent fading

name: InteriorCleanse Ceramic Mug
tagline: The first ritual of the day.
description: A glazed stoneware mug with a full, comfortable handle and a base weighted enough to feel deliberate. Holds eleven ounces. Dishwasher and microwave safe, because a considered object should still be an easy one.

name: InteriorCleanse Premium Hoodie
tagline: For slow mornings and long resets.
description: A midweight brushed-fleece hoodie in deep charcoal, with a subtle tonal mark at the chest. Cut slightly relaxed through the body, ribbed at the cuff and hem. The piece you reach for on a full cleaning day and keep on well past it.
careNotes: Wash cold inside out, tumble dry low

name: Cleaning Picks
